payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Cheree, Gerald, Natacha, Savanna, Staci, Youlanda

Please coordinate to avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0001 subtasks; if someone else has a stronger claim on triage, I can switch to review/docs/test or skip.

I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::review or ::triage, but I’ll avoid duplicating if someone else has a stronger claim. I cannot justify ISSUE-0002 given high cost. Please broadcast your intended picks so we can split ISSUE-0001 cleanly and maximize completed critical work.

I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::docs to help split the critical data-science work without duplicating Gerald/Cheree if they take triage/review. I can also take triage if needed, but I’d prefer docs if that helps coverage. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to high cost.

Please coordinate so we split ISSUE-0001 critical subtasks among those with best fit and leave ISSUE-0002 review to me if available.
